summary: Third Point Private Capital Partners, a closed-end fund, filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 371,692 Class I common shares for $10,000,000 in aggregate consideration, finalized October 1, 2026, with the sale dated September 1, 2026, alongside a Regulation D/S private placement to accredited and non-U.S. purchasers under subscription agreements. Item 8.01 disclosed an August 31, 2026 NAV per Class I share of $26.90, with no Class S or Class D shares outstanding. This is a routine private capital raise rather than a special situation; watch for future NAV marks and additional closings.
